job.style: a comparison of two related ideas

response.passage: Last Sunday, Rohan and his younger sister Meera visited the City Zoo, which houses 45 different species of animals. They were excited to see the new enclosure for the Bengal Tigers, which was built in 2022 to provide more space for the growing pride. While walking through the park, Rohan noticed that the visitors were quieter near the nocturnal house because the dim lighting helped the animals feel secure. Meera, however, thought the animals were just sleeping because they were bored. Near the exit, they met Mr. Gupta, the head zookeeper, who explained that the zoo maintains a strict schedule to ensure the animals remain healthy. He mentioned that the zoo staff works in two shifts to monitor the animals constantly. As they left, Rohan realized that observing animals requires patience and silence, unlike the noisy environment of a playground. He felt that the zoo was a place for learning rather than just entertainment. By the time they reached home at 6 PM, they had learned more about wildlife conservation than they ever did in their textbooks. They promised to return next year to see the new arrivals.
response.summary: Rohan and Meera visited the City Zoo and learned about animal behavior and conservation. They observed how the zoo environment is carefully managed to keep animals healthy and secure.
